results.name: Opening draft places 8 settlements + 8 roads and reaches phase=play
results.evidence:
phase=play settlements=8 roads=8 humanPicksViaUI=4 draftTime=23.6s
per-player: 2s/2r 2s/2r 2s/2r 2s/2r
human settlement #23 (Confirm button) | human road #28 (Confirm button) | human settlement #21 (Confirm button) | human road #26 (Confirm button)

results.name: All five resources can be gathered on contact, from hexes you own
results.evidence:
wood: 3->6 (+3) in ONE frame on contact — item 72, hex 3 (4 pips, 19 items, 16 left), hex claimed with 7 roads + a settlement
brick: 4->5 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 216, hex 10 (1 pips, 10 items, 9 left), hex already ours
wool: 3->4 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 120, hex 5 (1 pips, 10 items, 9 left), hex already ours
wheat: 2->5 (+3) in ONE frame on contact — item 144, hex 6 (2 pips, 13 items, 10 left), hex already ours
ore: 2->4 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 240, hex 11 (5 pips, 22 items, 20 left), hex already ours

results.name: The hex number means two things: how many items it holds and how fast they come back
results.evidence:
5-pip hex 4 (wheat): 22 items (declared 22), all 22 swept in 13 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 14s of 14s = 1.571 items/s sustained
1-pip hex 5 (wool): 10 items (declared 10), all 10 swept in 10 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 26s of 26s = 0.385 items/s sustained
more items on the better hex: true (22 vs 10) · faster regrowth: true (14s vs 26s) · 4.08x sustained supply
no swing speed involved: every item came off in a single frame of contact

results.name: Trading post trades at 4:1 and requires physical proximity
results.evidence:
at market (Great Market): trade ok=true ratio=4 wood-4 ore+1
far from any post (spot=null): ok=false reason="Head to the Great Market or one of your docks to trade" resourcesMoved=false
trade sheet forced open while far: opened=true confirmGreyed=true wood0 ore+0
full human loop at the market: prompt="Great MarketGIVE4GET14 of anything for t" -> sheet opened=true, Trade enabled=true ("4 Wood for 1 Ore"), wood-4 ore+1, sheet closed=false

results.name: Ports unlock on a coastal build and then trade at 3:1 / 2:1
results.evidence:
ports held before build: [1] -> after: [1,0,2]
port 0 special/wood: 2 roads laid to reach it, declared 2:1, quoted 2:1, charged 2:1, spent 2 got 1, unlocked=true (held before=false)
port 2 generic: 0 roads laid to reach it, declared 3:1, quoted 3:1, charged 3:1, spent 3 got 1, unlocked=true (held before=false)

results.name: Roads follow legal connection rules; illegal placements are rejected
Settlements obey the distance rule and require a connected road
results.evidence:
beside my own settlement #23 -> corner #22 rejected=true
no connected road (#6, distanceOk=true, roadTouching=false) -> rejected=true
legal corner #4 accepted=true, charged {"wood":4,"brick":4,"wheat":3,"wool":3}
its neighbour #3 now rejected=true

results.name: Cities upgrade only the owner's own settlements
results.evidence:
rival settlement #42 -> false (still a settlement)
empty corner #1 -> false
my settlement #23 -> true, now a city, charged {"wheat":4,"ore":6} vs {"wheat":4,"ore":6}
upgrading the same city again -> false; cities=1

results.name: All three development cards work (Knight, Road Building, Victory Point)
The Raider blocks the region for everyone except the player who moved it
results.evidence:
Raider moved by player 1 onto hex 3 (robberOwner=1)
owns a corner there: [false,true,false,true]  canGatherTile: [false,true,false,false]
sweeping the whole hex — mover +19 wood; player 3, who also owns a corner, +0 (0 blocked events); a player who owns nothing there +0

results.name: A hex you own nothing next to yields absolutely nothing
results.evidence:
hex 1 (brick) has no building of anyone's on it
stood on it for 3s (gained 0) then walked over all 13 of its items: gained 0 resources in total
the field is untouched: 13/13 items still standing (nothing was consumed and thrown away)
2 "blocked" events told the player why
then a settlement went up on corner 6: playerOwnsTile=true, canGatherTile=true, and the very next contact gave +1 brick

results.name: Bots gather, trade, build and score, with no resource gained outside a rules call
results.evidence:
45s of simulated play (phase=play); events {"build":18,"portUnlocked":1,"setupComplete":1,"blocked":18,"gained":105,"trade":5}
  You   gathered=0 built=4 trades=0 cards=0 roads=2 2S/0C vp=2
  Alex  gathered=33 built=4 trades=5 cards=0 roads=2 2S/0C vp=2
  Maya  gathered=28 built=5 trades=0 cards=0 roads=2 1S/1C vp=3
  Finn  gathered=44 built=5 trades=0 cards=0 roads=2 1S/1C vp=3
unexplained resource gains: 0
trades observed in this window: yes

results.name: Longest Road can change hands
results.evidence:
start holder=-1 lengths=[1,1,1,1]
after I lay 3 roads: holder=0 len=4 flags=[true,false,false,false] myVP=6
after rival out-builds me: holder=1 len=5 flags=[false,true,false,false] myVP=2 theirVP=6
award events: [{"player":1,"value":5}]

results.name: Largest Army can change hands
results.evidence:
start holder=-1
after I play 2 knights: holder=0 counts=[2,0,0,0] myVP=4
after Maya plays 3: holder=2 counts=[2,0,3,0] flags=[false,false,true,false] myVP=2
award events: [{"player":2,"value":3}]
